optimizedCv.targetRoleTitle: Mobile Application Engineer, Enterprise Knowledge Base

professionalSummary.text: Mobile Application Engineer with two years of experience developing and maintaining offline sync and search features for an enterprise knowledge base app on iOS and Android, reducing sync failure rates from 6.8% to 2.1% through delta-sync implementation.
professionalSummary.witness: Developed the delta-sync module for the knowledge base app (Kotlin and Swift), replacing the full-catalogue download with change-set downloads and a resumable transfer when field devices lose connectivity. Reduced the sync failure rate from 6.8 percent to 2.1 percent of sync attempts between the March and June releases, measured by the app analytics dashboard against the product's published baseline of 6.8 percent for the January to February period.

experienceHighlights.text: Reduced sync failure rate from 6.8% to 2.1% through delta-sync implementation, measured against published baseline.
experienceHighlights.witness: Reduced the sync failure rate from 6.8 percent to 2.1 percent of sync attempts between the March and June releases, measured by the app analytics dashboard against the product's published baseline of 6.8 percent for the January to February period.

experienceHighlights.text: Coordinated release contents with content team for four releases, covering sync and search changes while release manager handled scope and date.
experienceHighlights.witness: Coordinated release contents with the content team for four releases; my part covered the sync and search changes, while the release manager decided the release date and scope.

experienceHighlights.text: Triaged crash and sync reports from field staff, documenting root causes in engineering wiki and linking to fixing changes.
experienceHighlights.witness: Triaged crash and sync reports from field staff through the support queue, documenting root causes in the engineering wiki and linking each to the fixing change.

projectsAndWorkSamples.text: Delta-sync module implementation (Kotlin and Swift) enabling change-set downloads and resumable transfers for offline sync.
projectsAndWorkSamples.witness: Developed the delta-sync module for the knowledge base app (Kotlin and Swift), replacing the full-catalogue download with change-set downloads and a resumable transfer when field devices lose connectivity.

projectsAndWorkSamples.text: Sync-failure-rate report and delta-sync design note with dashboard export identifiers as verification trail.
projectsAndWorkSamples.witness: Work sample: the sync-failure-rate report exported from the app analytics dashboard (weekly rate, attempts, baseline line, release markers for March and June) and the delta-sync design note, with the dashboard export identifiers as a verification trail.

skills.text: Offline sync development (Kotlin, Swift), app quality indicator reporting, release coordination, crash report triage.
skills.witness: Responsibilities included offline sync development, quality-indicator reporting, release coordination and support triage for the knowledge base app over about two years.

optimizedCv.evidenceBoundary: The materials establish the candidate's direct involvement in developing delta-sync, reducing sync failure rates, coordinating releases, triaging reports, and documenting limitations. They do not establish specific iOS/Android platform details beyond Kotlin/Swift, nor do they confirm the candidate's role in documenting known limitations (req_879e5309844c) or the exact nature of 'hand-over conditions'.

decisionBoundary.statement: Human review required due to unverified claims about iOS/Android platform specifics and missing documentation of known limitations.
